functionality.rationale: Moving fixtures between CTest and configure must preserve every positive and negative assertion.

security.rationale: A false-positive fixture result could allow memory-unsafe ABI layout or signature drift.

performance.rationale: The repair exists because runtime recursive compilation did not terminate promptly on Windows.

compatibility.rationale: All ABI v1 positive and breaking compile fixtures must retain their original verdicts.

concurrency.rationale: The change removes nested subprocess trees but retains independent configure-time compiler probes.

platform.rationale: CMake try_compile and compile failure diagnostics must behave consistently with AppleClang, Clang, and MSVC.

persistence.rationale: The repair creates no product persisted data or migration behavior.

adr.rationale: The repair preserves the ABI v1 policy already accepted by ADR 0001 and ADR 0003.

architecture.rationale: Only the execution phase of internal ABI compile fixtures changes.

roadmap.rationale: The repair restores a quality gate and does not complete a product milestone.

acceptance.note: Accepted by the integration owner after repository verification.
